description.en: CommandCode multi-model API with Chat, Responses and Claude Messages, API-key account setup and model-specific routing.
description.zh: CommandCode 多模型 API，支持 Chat、Responses 与 Claude Messages，提供 API Key 账号配置与按模型协议路由。

docs.en: Create a CommandCode API key in Studio (https://commandcode.ai/studio) and add an account. Use full model IDs, for example deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash. Claude models use Messages; other models use Chat and, where advertised by the official catalog, Responses. Models, the 5-hour and weekly credit windows and the remaining plan credits all come from the account itself: the model list is this key's own GET /models, and the quota card shows the membership tier with when each window resets. Provider API docs: https://commandcode.ai/docs/provider
docs.zh: 在 CommandCode Studio（https://commandcode.ai/studio）创建 API Key 后添加账号。使用完整模型 ID，例如 deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash。Claude 仅走 Messages；其他模型走 Chat，官方目录声明支持时可走 Responses。模型目录、5 小时与每周额度窗口、剩余套餐额度全部来自该账号本身：模型取该 Key 的 GET /models，配额卡片显示会员等级与各窗口的重置时间。接口文档：https://commandcode.ai/docs/provider

description.en: Paste a CommandCode API key from Studio. Models are discovered automatically. Provider requests are billed by CommandCode.
description.zh: 粘贴从 CommandCode Studio 创建的 API Key；模型会自动发现，Provider 请求由 CommandCode 计费。
